items.event: LPGA CME Group Tour Championship, final round (Naples, FL)
items.line: Japan's Yuri Yoshida started Sunday one shot behind 54-hole leader A Lim Kim (-18), level with Jeeno Thitikul, with Nelly Korda two back. The winner takes $4M. Early swing: Thitikul eagled the 1st and Kim made double bogey there.

items.event: PGA Tour RSM Classic, Monday finish (Sea Island)
items.line: Rain pushed the PGA Tour's last event of the season to Monday. Thorbjornsen, Penge and Neergaard-Petersen shared the lead at -9 going into R3, with 16 players within two shots. Top 100 in the FedEx Cup standings keep their 2027 cards, so the card bubble is decided in the final round.

items.line: Carlos Alcaraz won his first ATP Finals title, beating top seed Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7). In doubles, debutants Arribage/Olivetti beat Arevalo/Pavic 10-6 in the match tiebreak.

items.event: UCL league phase MD5: Arsenal v Dortmund, Man City v Napoli, Real Madrid v PSV
items.line: Arsenal have won 12 league-phase home games in a row and face Dortmund, who have Ethan Nwaneri on loan from them. De Bruyne returns to City with Napoli, and Haaland has scored in all three of his UCL games against Napoli. Mbappé needs one goal for 75 in the UCL.

items.line: PSG have scored 20 goals in four league-phase games, the most of any club, and host Roma. Bayern visit Lille, and United go to Sporting having won only 1 of their last 11 UCL away games. Earlier, Lamine Yamal needs one goal at Sabah to become the youngest player to reach 15 UCL goals.
